question.text: Within what time period must a depository apply for a certificate of commencement of business after receiving its certificate of registration?

explanation.text: The Logic: A depository must apply to SEBI for a certificate of commencement of business within one year from the date of receiving the certificate of registration. The Trap: Other timelines such as six months, two years, or three months are distractors and not the prescribed period. Note: SEBI considers systems and safeguards before granting commencement of business.
